svg.title: Laboratory decisions: validation, conditional findings and optional research
svg.desc: 1. Configure and map laboratory input; Validate complete FHIR?; Validate with local Matchbox / HL7; Disabled / not applicable; Aggregate or retain items; 2. A1: check the whole laboratory set; 3. Persist the audited A1 report; 4. Select the next command; A2: research-evidence --scope lookup; A3: research-evidence --scope studies; 5. Clinician review and scoped reuse

g.text: 1. Configure and map laboratory input
Code + system + name + specimen/method + value/statistics + unit/system + reference context
Preflight checks mappings, types, paths, profile and source editions
Validate complete FHIR?
Enabled + file / FHIR-in-CSV
Validate with local Matchbox / HL7
Installed profile + binding terminology
Retain OperationOutcome; continue semantic checks
Failed validation affects the configured exit status
Disabled / not applicable
Scalar CSV/DB: not_applicable when selected
DB JSON: export for complete-document validation
Aggregate or retain items
distinct: group contexts; calculate / pool statistics
items: retain source IDs for A1 review
2. A1: check the whole laboratory set
Declared systems → lookup; missing systems → verify exact candidates
Supported candidate → conditional match; source systems/specimen stay unchanged
Check name/context, numeric quantities, code–unit fit and reference consistency
3. Persist the audited A1 report
CSV + HTML + field decisions + five scope results / completeness / reasons
Distinguish missing metadata, unverified findings and demonstrated errors
4. Select the next command
A2/A3 require audited distinct semantic sets
A2: research-evidence --scope lookup
Read grouped A1 and sidecars; retrieve candidates
Local model → check against actual terminology
Record sources, proposals and review conditions
A3: research-evidence --scope studies
Read the same grouped A1; include AI lookup
Python retrieves studies; local model extracts
Verify quote / analyte / number / unit / interval type
5. Clinician review and scoped reuse
Review field and whole-set findings, short reasons, source support and applicability
A numeric value is a format check; study evidence needs clinical interpretation
Approve / reject / defer in a review copy; recheck approved targets and factors on reuse

svg.text: For A2/A3: output.mode="distinct", without value in aggregation.group_by; rerun A1 when needed.
